briefings.title: China Steps In as Trump’s Ceasefire UNRAVELS | China Decode
briefings.channel: The Prof G Pod – Scott Galloway
briefings.tldr: The fragile Middle East ceasefire has collapsed into a U.S.-led blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, placing China in a precarious position: Beijing is facing 50% tariff threats from the Trump administration over alleged military aid to Iran while simultaneously grappling with massive energy supply chain disruptions.
